text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that was it. On that day years 
ago, a Prank Monster was born...! Which 
means—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's right~! Time to run completely 
wild!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wake up! On this momentous day, you shall 
be reborn. As the sixth warrior, 'Gabu 
Gabu Black'!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't wanna. If I become your ally, 
no one will fight me anymore."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You stubborn blockhead! In that case, I'll 
take you down with everything I've got 
using my special birthday move!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Here goes, starting with the ultimate 
'Congrats Chant'! Con-gra-tuuu! 
Con-gra-tuuu!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And here's the finishing blow! "Final 
Present Craaaash"!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... This feels kind of awkward to deal 
with...
